code:
curl -X POST https://api.mayarin.xyz/v1/payment-intents \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $MAYARIN_SECRET_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: order-4711" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "merchant": {
      "id": "M-1",
      "name": "Warung Kopi",
      "city": "Jakarta",
      "countryCode": "ID"
    },
    "amount": { "amount": "50000.00", "asset": "IDR" },
    "payment": { "asset": "USDC", "chain": "base" },
    "merchantReference": "order-4711"
  }'

# An agent with no account, no API key and no checkout page.
# Ask what the resource costs before deciding to call it.
curl https://api-testnet.mayarin.xyz/x402/resources/fx-quote/payment-required

# Or just call it. The gate answers with its own terms.
curl -i https://api-testnet.mayarin.xyz/premium/fx-quote
# HTTP/1.1 402 Payment Required
# PAYMENT-REQUIRED: <price, chains, assets, deadline>

# Sign one EIP-3009 authorization for exactly that amount, then ask again.
curl -i https://api-testnet.mayarin.xyz/premium/fx-quote \
  -H "PAYMENT-SIGNATURE: $AUTHORIZATION"
# HTTP/1.1 200 OK
# PAYMENT-RESPONSE: <transaction, network>

# The merchant behind it was priced in IDR and settled in USDC,
# exactly as it would be for a person at a checkout.

# List an invoice so agents can find it.
curl -X POST https://api.mayarin.xyz/v1/invoices/invc_123/list \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $MAYARIN_SECRET_KEY"

# Any agent can discover it — no merchant id needed.
curl https://api.mayarin.xyz/x402/payables

# Pay the full balance with one signature.
curl -i https://api.mayarin.xyz/x402/payables/invoice/invc_123 \
  -H "PAYMENT-SIGNATURE: $AUTHORIZATION"
